## Response format

Return exactly one JSON object with this shape (JSON Schema: `$defs/aiResponse` in notes.schema.json):

```json
{
  "layerName": "AI v1",
  "summary": "Three or four sentences on the track's structure and the biggest opportunities.",
  "replies": [
    {
      "toNoteId": "n_muqr1fqh85cb12abb23e",
      "body": "Agree / disagree / addition, specific to that note."
    }
  ],
  "notes": [
    {
      "type": "pin",
      "startSeconds": 88.9,
      "title": "short title",
      "body": "specific body",
      "category": "structure",
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "type": "interval",
      "startSeconds": 140,
      "endSeconds": 180,
      "title": "short title",
      "body": "specific body",
      "category": "loop",
      "confidence": "low"
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules: `confidence` is one of low | medium | high. `startSeconds`/`endSeconds` are seconds from the start of the file (0 ≤ t ≤ 600.000). `category` must be one of the listed categories. `toNoteId` must be an id from the human notes above. Output only the JSON.
